description: Create a test run from chosen test cases — manual (default) or KaneAI (run_type: "kaneai"). Each included test case becomes a TEST RUN INSTANCE — the executable copy of that test inside the run, which carries its own status, remarks and exactly one Configuration. The cases must match the run type: KaneAI runs only take KaneAI-authored cases with completed code generation; manual runs only take manual cases. Optionally attach existing milestones, file into a run folder, and apply a Configuration to all instances (KaneAI configurations must be compatible with each case's platform — web/mobile-app/mobile-browser and iOS/Android).

assignee.description: Assign every created instance to this organization member — email, username, or user id. If the user has not said who to assign, ASK them (or confirm no assignee) before creating; never guess.

configuration_id.description: Apply ONE Configuration to every included test case (the configuration's top-level id from tm_list_configurations)

configuration_ids.description: Apply MULTIPLE Configurations: each included test case gets one test run instance per configuration (case × configuration), like the UI's Add Configuration checkboxes

folder_id.description: Test-run folder to file the run into

is_sequential.description: KaneAI runs only: execute the instances sequentially (default false).

milestone_ids.description: Existing milestone ids to attach the run to

run_type.description: Run type (default manual). "kaneai" creates a KaneAI run: only KaneAI-authored test cases can be included, and configurations must be kane-supported and platform-compatible.

name: tm_create_test_run
title: Create Test Run
